note: Structural-variation study (2026-11-09). defs as exp/2026-10-12-population/tpcds-defs.json; judge = hand-written judge bases written from the business definitions (not from the library's structured definitions and not compiled by metric::compile); judge_dims = hand-written fact-to-dimension join conditions for slicing.

defs.name: 一号经理商品门店销售额
defs.definition: 一号经理商品门店销售额 = 品类经理编号为 1（item.i_manager_id = 1）的商品的门店销售行的扩展售价（store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price）之和；销售行经商品键（ss_item_sk）关联商品表，按销售日期（ss_sold_date_sk）归属期间；每个销售行计一次

judge.from: store_sales join item on store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk join date_dim on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk

defs.name: 登记顾客门店销售额
defs.definition: 登记顾客门店销售额 = 门店销售行的扩展售价（store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price）之和，只计顾客（customer）、商品（item）和门店（store）都关联得上的销售行；按销售日期（ss_sold_date_sk）归属期间；每个销售行计一次

judge.from: store_sales join customer on store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk join item on store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk join store on store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk join date_dim on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk

defs.name: 中型门店优惠券金额
defs.definition: 中型门店优惠券金额 = 员工数（store.s_number_employees）在 200 到 295 之间的门店上、关联得上家庭人口信息（household_demographics）且 hd_dep_count = 0 或 hd_vehicle_count > -1 的门店销售行的优惠券金额（store_sales.ss_coupon_amt）之和；按销售日期（ss_sold_date_sk）归属期间；每个销售行计一次

judge.from: store_sales join household_demographics on store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk join store on store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk join date_dim on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
judge.filter: store.s_number_employees between 200 and 295 and (household_demographics.hd_dep_count = 0 or household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > -1)

defs.name: 门店退货金额
defs.definition: 门店退货金额 = 关联得上门店（store）的门店退货行的退货金额（store_returns.sr_return_amt）之和，按退货日期（sr_returned_date_sk）归属期间；每个退货行计一次

judge.from: store_returns join store on store_returns.sr_store_sk = store.s_store_sk join date_dim on store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk

defs.name: 门店综合销售额
defs.definition: 门店综合销售额 = 门店销售行的 ((ss_ext_list_price − ss_ext_wholesale_cost − ss_ext_discount_amt) + ss_ext_sales_price) / 2 之和，只计关联得上顾客（customer）的销售行；按销售日期（ss_sold_date_sk）归属期间；每个销售行计一次

judge.from: store_sales join customer on store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk join date_dim on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
